questions.question: _________ is the distribution and exchange of goods and services.
Which of the following persons is NOT an office worker?
Commercial services are broadly divided into ________ and ________.
An aid to trade that compensates when there is loss of life or property is ________.
Which of the following is NOT a reward for being truthful?
The two major divisions of trade are ________ and ________.
options: B. Home trade and foreign trade

questions.question: Keeping records of all members of staff including their transfers, promotions and appraisals is a function of the ________ department.
Which of the following is NOT a professional associated with Business Studies?
A company gets the following as rewards for adhering to honesty in business EXCEPT ________.
The act of passing information from one place to another is called ________.
Import and export are components of ________.
All human efforts, whether physical or mental, directed towards the production of wealth are known as ________.
All chemicals sold in Nigeria must be registered with ________.
Keeping a person in check or on guard to ensure that rules and regulations are being followed is known as ________.
All the following are forms of business organisation EXCEPT ________.
The production of goods and supply of services require ________.
options: A. Land, labour, management and money
B. Land, labour, money and raw materials
C. Land, labour, cash and enterprise
D. Land, labour, capital and entrepreneurs

questions.question: Ethics refers to ________.
options: B. Values and rules of a school
C. Values, rules and behaviour that govern people
D. Values and rules governing school examinations

questions.question: All the following are factors that may cause people to steal or tell lies EXCEPT ________.
options: A. To cover up bad behaviour
D. To save face over a promise not kept

questions.question: The following are extractive occupations EXCEPT ________.
All the following are features of an entrepreneur EXCEPT ________.
options: C. Determines what is to be produced

questions.question: A consumer must derive ________ from every good used.
An entrepreneur must be able to ________ for the business.
________ is the reward of an entrepreneur.
Entrepreneurship brings about ________ in the economy.
If chemicals are not properly handled, they could cause the following EXCEPT ________.
Which of the following occupations is against the law of Nigeria?
Which of the following industries takes raw materials from the earth?
The money paid to an employee for services rendered is called ________.
Machines are called capital goods because ________.
options: A. They are not easy to get
B. They help in the production of other goods
D. They are difficult to move

questions.question: Buying and selling of goods is known as ________.
A person who buys goods and services for personal use is called a ________.
A business owned and controlled by one person is called ________.
A business owned by two or more persons who agree to operate together is called ________.
Which of the following is an advantage of sole proprietorship?
Which of the following is a characteristic of partnership?
options: A. It must have only one owner
B. Profits and losses may be shared among partners
C. It cannot engage in business
D. It has no agreement between owners

questions.question: The process of recording financial transactions of a business is called ________.
Which of the following is an example of a direct service?
Which of the following is an example of an indirect commercial service?
One major importance of entrepreneurship is that it creates ________.
Which factor of production includes natural resources such as forests, rivers and minerals?

essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer any three (3) questions in this section. Write your answers clearly on the answer booklet provided.

questions.question:
(a) Define occupation.
(b) List and explain four factors which affect occupation.
(c) Differentiate between direct and indirect services.

(a) What is truthfulness in business?
(b) List and explain four attributes of being truthful.
(c) Outline four factors that cause people to lie.

(a) Define entrepreneurship.
(b) List four importance of entrepreneurship.
(c) Outline five successful entrepreneurs in Nigeria.

(a) Define sole proprietorship.
(b) Define partnership.
(c) State four advantages of sole proprietorship.
(d) List four characteristics of partnership.

Explain in detail any four (4) of the following:
(i) Consumer
(ii) Capital
(iii) Land
(iv) Book-keeping
(v) Entrepreneur
